notes_for_editor: Identity inferred, not stated: firelookout.ca's Cynthia record (Ferguson Trail, Temagami; 47.136111, -80.057222) is close to but not identical with Wikipedia's Mount Ferguson coordinates (47.13639, -80.05861). No source calls this tower 'Cynthia' or ties that name to the mountain; Wikipedia only places the mountain near the Cynthia township boundary. Conflicts left open: (1) elevation 405 m on the firelookout record against 415 m for the mountain on Wikipedia; (2) the firelookout record says the steel tower appears on Gogama 41P, 3rd ed., 1977, while Wikipedia and the Temagami atlas put its dismantling about 1975. Record status is 'unknown'; the sources support 'removed', which a human may want to set. No build date or design source found. Climbable is set to false only because the tower is gone; no source describes the summit today or its access. Caribou Mountain tower is a separate site, mentioned in the story to tell it apart from the Cynthia tower.
